3. By means of the instant application the applicant Rohit Nirmal seeks bail in Case Crime No. 146 of 2022, under sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and section 3/4, Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, P.S. Maheshganj, District Pratapgarh.

5. sentences.text: 6. Before the doctor, who conducted the victim's medico legal examination, she stated that she had gone with the applicant out of our own free will.
No injury was found on the body of the victim during her medical examination and as per the radiological examination her age was opined to be 18 years.

7. In the statement of the victim recorded under section 164 CrPC also the alleged victim stated that she had gone with the applicant out of her own will and that her date of birth is 25th of April 2004.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the facts that as per the statement made by the alleged victim as also as per her radiological examination report, the victim is a major and she has categorically stated that she had gone with the applicant out of her own free will, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
